parts:
I have the library() calls in the server.R file for all the packages I use.  Just a minute ago I tried also putting the library() calls in the ui.R file since shinyGridster and ShinyDash are UI packages.  That didn't work though.  

ui.R file


library(ShinyDash)
library(shinyGridster)
shinyUI(navbarPage("Dashboard App",
                  
                   tabPanel("Home",
                           
                            fluidPage(
                              h2("Welcome to your dashboard!"),
                              h6("This web app has been designed to show the operational metrics important to you!"),
                  
                            gridster(tile.width = 400, tile.height = 1000,
                                     marginx = 16, marginy = 16,
                              
                              gridsterItem(col = 1, row = 1, sizex = 2,
                                           sizey = 2,
                               
                                gaugeOutput("livegauge", width = 250, height = 250,
                                            units = "Recorded Docs", min = 0, max = 10,
                                            title = "Incorrect Fees")
                                )
)
),

A short version of my server file is:
server.R
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(lubridate)
library(ShinyDash)
library(shinyGridster)

shinyServer(function(input, output) {

output$livegauge <- renderGauge({
               running_mean <- mean(corrections$FeesAddedCount)
               round(running_mean, 1)
             })
